description.narrative: The main objective of the WEE action is to address key constraints to women's financial inclusion and economic empowerment in Sub-Saharan Africa. The action recognizes that support to women's entrepreunership and improved economic agency is essential drivers for scaling private sector development and promoting gender equality. As such, the WEE action is expected to both contribute to various Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) of Agenda 2030, namely SDGs 1, 5 and 8, and GAP II.

title.narrative: Expected key outcomes include increased financial inclusion, increased access to financial and digital products and services for women and improved access to finance for MSMEs resulting from a wider adoption of gender lens investing strategies by local financial service providers and broader mobilisation of international, development finance and investment communities.Key intermediate outputs shall include:a) Leverage public and private sector resources in support of improved access to finance for women in subSaharan Africa through the implementation of the Women`s Financial Inclusion Facility (WFIF), consisting of the Women`s World Banking Capital Partners Fund II (WWBCP II or the Fund II) and the Women`s World Banking Technical Assistance Programme (TAP).b) Investing in and further developing, through the mobilisation of technical assistance resources inclusive FSPs which:8 Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 1: Ending poverty in all its forms everywhere9 SDG 5: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls10 SDG 8: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable growth, full and productive employment and decent work for allAnnex I Delegation Agreement WFIF Page 7 of 26i. Promote access to and the use of diverse financial products and services for women clients;ii. Promote gender diversity at all levels of the Portfolio Companies;iii. Demonstrate a strong business case for gender lens investing by achieving economic returns for Class A Limited Partners and achieving capital preservation for Class B Limited Partners via medium to longterm capital appreciation.

Promote access to and the use of diverse financial products and services for women clients;ii. Promote gender diversity at all levels of the Portfolio Companies;iii. Demonstrate a strong business case for gender lens investing by achieving economic returns for Class A Limited Partners and achieving capital preservation for Class B Limited Partners via medium to longterm capital appreciation.
